cdad7914e6.q: Why is Aslee Maslow ending Pretty AF Powerhouse podcast for the 2026 season?
cdad7914e6.a: Aslee Maslow decided to end the 2026 season to step back and simplify her business. She realized she was making decisions too quickly without fully thinking them through, which led to having many unfinished projects. She wants to take time through the end of the year to build systems that will serve her long-term goals and decide what she wants to commit to when 2027 rolls around, rather than rushing into decisions and experiencing burnout.

60b766567d.q: What does Aslee Maslow recommend when making business decisions amid conflicting advice from multiple coaches?
